sources.snippet: Introduction SEA-LION stands for Southeast Asian Languages In One Network. Apertus-SEA-LION-v4-8B-IT is a 8-billion parameter model built upon the Apertus-8B-Instruct architecture. To ensure domain adaptation for the region, the model underwent rigorous post-training on a curated dataset of approximately 8.54 million instruction-text pairs.
